newsitem.title: USA: ALPINE SKIING-SYKORA WINS FIRST MEN'S WORLD CUP SLALOM.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-SYKORA WINS FIRST MEN'S WORLD CUP SLALOM.

text.p: Thomas Sykora won the first men's World Cup slalom of the season Sunday, edging Thomas Stangassinger in a one-two Austrian sweep.

Sykora prevailed on the strength of a strong first run, then skied in control on the second for a combined time of 1:46.03. Stangassinger clocked 1:46.32 and Kjetil Andre Aamodt of Norway took third in 1:46.91.
Christian Mayer of Austria was fourth, Ole Christian Furuseth of Norway fifth and Michael Tritscher of Austria sixth.
